SELECT t.xmid, t.xmdm, t.xmzwmc, t.xmywmc, t.pym, t.qtdm, t.xmdw, t.xmjd, t.xmlx, t.jsbz, t.xs, t.sjxhl, t.tybz, t.dybz, t.zsbz, t.sfbz, t.gzl, t.his_fydm, t.his_jyxmmc, t.zsk_xmdm, t.zsk_xmmc, t.item_type, t.lcyy FROM sys_jyxm_full t WHERE 1=1
AND (t.xmzwmc LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR t.pym LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR t.xmdm LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR t.qtdm LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))
AND t.xmid IN (SELECT xmid FROM sys_cjdzb WHERE sb_djid = #{sbDjid})
AND (t.xmdm IS NULL OR t.xmid = (SELECT MIN(t2.xmid) FROM sys_jyxm_full t2 WHERE t2.xmdm = t.xmdm)) ORDER BY t.xmid

SELECT t.xmid, t.xmdm, t.xmzwmc, t.pym, t.xmdw, t.xmjd FROM sys_jyxm_full t WHERE (t.pym LIKE CONCAT('%',#{pym},'%') OR t.xmzwmc LIKE CONCAT('%',#{pym},'%') OR t.xmdm LIKE CONCAT('%',#{pym},'%')) AND (t.xmdm IS NULL OR t.xmid = (SELECT MIN(t2.xmid) FROM sys_jyxm_full t2 WHERE t2.xmdm = t.xmdm)) ORDER BY t.xmdm LIMIT 50

SELECT t.xmid, t.xmdm, t.xmzwmc, t.pym, t.xmdw, t.xmjd FROM sys_jyxm_full t WHERE (t.pym LIKE CONCAT('%',#{pym},'%') OR t.xmzwmc LIKE CONCAT('%',#{pym},'%') OR t.xmdm LIKE CONCAT('%',#{pym},'%'))
AND t.xmid IN (SELECT xmid FROM sys_cjdzb WHERE sb_djid = #{sbDjid})
AND (t.xmdm IS NULL OR t.xmid = (SELECT MIN(t2.xmid) FROM sys_jyxm_full t2 WHERE t2.xmdm = t.xmdm)) ORDER BY t.xmdm LIMIT 50
